## Summary

Test-first contract for the follow-source interface and unlock/persistence logic using a mocked Steamworks session, written before the implementation features (F3/F4). Defines the interface the renderer and unlock logic consume so the Steam SDK stays behind an abstraction.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A mockable `FollowSource` interface is defined (init, isSteamAvailable, openStorePage, isFollowing, claim) with a deterministic fake implementation.
- [ ] Unit tests (`tests/steam-follow/`) cover: follow detected → unlock flow triggered; already-unlocked → no re-verification prompt; Steam absent → graceful degraded path (no crash); choose-one-of-three catalog resolution; unlock persistence round-trip across simulated launches.
- [ ] Tests run and pass under `--project unit` (fast, no browser).
- [ ] The interface contract documents that the renderer never imports the Steam SDK directly.

## Minimal Implementation

- Test-only feature: interface + test doubles + unit tests.
- Reference the launcher item's content-locator abstraction (CG-0MSMAD19O0084CAW) for the dependency-injection pattern.

## Dependencies

- Parent blocked-by CG-0MSMAD19O0084CAW (launcher) for the abstraction pattern it establishes.

## Deliverables

- `FollowSource` interface + mocked unit tests.
data.title: F2: Mocked follow-source test contract

# Task: Contract tests for the merged-core topology (Option A)

## Goal

As a maintainer I have an executable contract for the Option A end state, so
the migration (F3–F6) cannot silently land a topology that contradicts the
decision.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `scripts/configs/repo-layout.json` resolves a single `core` target whose
   name/slug is `Tableau-Card-Engine`, and no `tableau-card-engine-core`
   target exists.
2. A test asserts each game's expected `core` submodule URL is
   `git@github.com:TheWizardsCode/Tableau-Card-Engine.git` (the value the
   migrated game repos must carry).
3. A test asserts `Tableau-Card-Engine` declares **no game submodules** (the
   distribution composes games as siblings, keeping the submodule graph
   acyclic).
4. A test asserts the discovery plugin's composition path is sibling-only
   (`<root>/<path>/<siblingScenePath>`), with no `.gitmodules`-based game
   resolution.
5. The new/extended suite fails against the current (pre-migration) state and
   is the guard that turns green as F3–F5 land; the script unit suites
   (`tests/scripts/`) otherwise stay green.

## Minimal Implementation

- Extend `tests/scripts/extract-repos.test.ts` and/or
  `tests/scripts/repo-publication.test.ts` with the topology assertions.
- Where the end state is not yet true, author the assertions so they fail now
  and pass after F3–F5 (document the intent inline); do not weaken existing
  coverage.
- No production code changes in this item.

**Key Files:**
- `tests/scripts/extract-repos.test.ts`
- `tests/scripts/repo-publication.test.ts`
- `scripts/configs/repo-layout.json` (read-only)

**Dependencies:** None.

**Deliverables:** The failing-then-green contract suite that defines the
merged-core end state.
data.title: Contract tests for the merged-core topology (Option A)
